title: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 9.2.0 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Certificate… (CVE-2026-91875)
description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules versions 9.2.0 through 10.0.3 have an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the SessionAPI component. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to potentially cause information exposure and unauthorized access. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 8.7. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
